rationale: User requested ordinary owning-module paths and Polars-style convenience preludes, without compatibility aliases. Remove the four reference namespaces, add curated preludes and explicit experimental module documentation, and add reusable Wiener batch workspace/cached models. The new WienerModelError variant reports workspace borrowing; all of these pre-alpha API changes are intentional. Numerical sampler defaults, checkpoint schemas, research exactness classifications and frozen candidate evidence are unchanged. Actual language-level semver compatibility with the preceding namespace API is not claimed.
